# netbox_virtual_chassis_list (Data Source)

Lists virtual_chassis objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_chassis_list" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-virtual_chassis" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: domain, domain__empty, domain__ic, domain__ie, domain__iew, domain__iregex, domain__isw, domain__n, domain__nic, domain__nie, domain__niew, domain__nisw, domain__regex, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, master_id, master_id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `virtual_chassis_list` (Attributes List) The matching virtual_chassis_list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_chassis_list))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--virtual_chassis_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_chassis_list`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `domain` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `master_id` (Number) Id of the device acting as chassis master.
- `member_count` (Number) Number of members of the virtual chassis.
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
